chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 166 – Li Huowang's Last Bet: Slitting His Own Throat
chapter_meta_description: With decay dead and Danyangzi closing in, Li Huowang rides to the Ao-Jing Sect, slits his own throat, and steps onto the Thousand Greats Record. A desperate gambit with no guarantee of victory.
og_title: Chapter 166 – Not Yet Won: Li Huowang's Final Suicide Gambit
og_description: His last ally dead. His literacy gone. His escape route blocked. Li Huowang's only move left is to bet his own death against Danyangzi's.
twitter_title: Chapter 166 – Not Yet Won: Li Huowang's Final Suicide Gambit
twitter_description: With nothing left to lose, Li Huowang slits his own throat and stands on the Thousand Greats Record. This is not despair—it's a death-trade.
